scenarios.goal_zh: 想要独立的桌面客户端，而不是浏览器标签页
scenarios.goal_en: Run DSH as a standalone desktop app, not a browser tab
scenarios.why_zh: 开箱即用的桌面体验：自动复用本机已运行的实例，或用内置运行时一键启动，无需安装 Node.js/CLI；支持远程实例连接、托盘常驻和异常恢复。
scenarios.why_en: An out-of-the-box desktop experience: auto-reuse a running local instance or launch the bundled runtime with no Node.js/CLI install required, plus remote-instance connections, tray residency, and crash recovery.

scenarios.goal_zh: 更方便地管理和发现插件
scenarios.goal_en: Manage and discover plugins
scenarios.why_zh: 在浏览器面板中管理 repository 插件，并提供开发引导。
scenarios.why_en: Manage repository plugins in a browser console with plugin-development guidance.

scenarios.goal_zh: 把现有业务代码转成 Agent 可调用能力
scenarios.goal_en: Turn existing application code into agent-callable capabilities
scenarios.why_zh: 从用户授权的前端、后端或全栈源码生成 Function、MCP Tools、业务 Skills 和离线测试，并可作为 DSH Bundle 安装。
scenarios.why_en: Generate Functions, MCP tools, workflow Skills, and offline tests from user-authorized frontend, backend, or full-stack source code, packaged as an installable DSH bundle.

scenarios.goal_zh: 看清后台任务进度
scenarios.goal_en: Track background tasks
scenarios.why_zh: 在对话页显示任务进度和实时输出 tail。
scenarios.why_en: Show task progress and a live output tail in the conversation view.

scenarios.goal_zh: 定时或按事件唤醒 Agent
scenarios.goal_en: Wake an agent on a schedule or event
scenarios.why_zh: 覆盖周期任务，以及文件、命令、HTTP、进程和 Webhook 事件。
scenarios.why_en: Cover scheduled runs plus file, command, HTTP, process, and webhook events.

scenarios.goal_zh: 请求经常因网络波动或超时中断，不想每次都手动补一句「继续」
scenarios.goal_en: Keep requests from dying to network hiccups and timeouts without manually saying "continue" every time
scenarios.why_zh: 监听实时事件流，回合因非人为原因失败后自动补发「继续」：错误分类只恢复临时性故障，自适应退避避免对故障上游狂轰滥炸，支持模板化继续文本与浏览器通知，参数可在插件设置卡片中调整。
scenarios.why_en: Watches the live event streams and auto-sends a queued "继续" after non-human failures: error classification resumes only transient faults, adaptive backoff avoids hammering a broken upstream, and templated continue text plus browser notifications keep you in the loop — all configurable from the plugin settings card.

scenarios.goal_zh: 更顺手地阅读和操作长对话
scenarios.goal_en: Navigate and annotate long conversations
scenarios.why_zh: 快速跳转用户消息节点，并像 Codex 一样选中文本批注。
scenarios.why_en: Jump between user-message nodes and attach Codex-style annotations.

scenarios.goal_zh: 像 Codex 一样用 @ 引用工作区文件
scenarios.goal_en: Reference workspace files with @ mentions
scenarios.why_zh: 在输入框内按 @ 搜索工作区文件并把内容附进 prompt，免去手动复制粘贴。
scenarios.why_en: @-search workspace files in the composer and attach their contents to the prompt, no copy-paste needed.

scenarios.goal_zh: 在对话中生成交互式界面
scenarios.goal_en: Render interactive UI in chat
scenarios.why_zh: 在回复中渲染图表、表单、测验、Mermaid 和 3D 场景。
scenarios.why_en: Render charts, forms, quizzes, Mermaid diagrams, and 3D scenes inline.

scenarios.goal_zh: 让 Agent 操作真实设计画布
scenarios.goal_en: Let agents operate a real design canvas
scenarios.why_zh: 创建、编辑、预览和验证可交互的多页面 OpenPencil 设计稿。
scenarios.why_en: Create, edit, preview, and validate interactive multi-page OpenPencil designs.

scenarios.goal_zh: 给 DSH 增加视觉理解能力
scenarios.goal_en: Add visual understanding to DSH
scenarios.why_zh: modlens 把图片转成 OCR/布局/语义结构化证据；dsh-vision-toolkit 覆盖图片问答、长截图 OCR、UI 还原与像素对比；纯文本模型也可经 Luna 转写桥接继续处理图片。dsh-vision-proxy 则保持 DeepSeek 大脑，把附加图片自动经任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM 转译成文字（默认免费匿名端点，零配置）。
scenarios.why_en: modlens turns images into structured OCR/layout/semantics evidence; dsh-vision-toolkit covers image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, UI restoration, and pixel diffs — or bridge pure-text models to image input via a Luna transcription adapter. dsh-vision-proxy keeps DeepSeek the brain and auto-transcribes attached images via any OpenAI-compatible VLM — a keyed fast path (default qwen3.7-flash; DashScope/Zhipu/OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint), or local Ollama auto-detected with zero config.

scenarios.goal_zh: 让 Agent 自己搜索网页和 X，答案带引用
scenarios.goal_en: Let the agent search the web and X with citations
scenarios.why_zh: 在对话中直接搜索、抓取并返回带引用的结构化证据，纯文本模型也能基于来源回答。
scenarios.why_en: Search and fetch from the web/X inline, returning cited structured evidence so text-only models answer from sources.

scenarios.goal_zh: 在开发对话里直接检查和操作当前网页
scenarios.goal_en: Inspect and operate the current web page from your dev conversation
scenarios.why_zh: 把完整 DSH Web 嵌进 Chrome 侧边栏，按 prompt 显式授权当前标签页，DSH 能在同一对话里读取 DOM、样式、console 报错并操作页面，无需另开浏览器专用对话。
scenarios.why_en: Embeds the full DSH Web in a Chrome side panel; grant the current tab per prompt so DSH can read the DOM, styles, and console errors and interact with the page inside your existing conversation instead of a separate browser chat.

scenarios.goal_zh: 把侧边栏升级成完整工作台
scenarios.goal_en: Turn the sidebar into a workbench
scenarios.why_zh: 内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，并支持第三方扩展注册新 Tab。
scenarios.why_en: File rendering/editing, terminal, Git, and subagents built in, with third-party tab extensions.

scenarios.goal_zh: 在终端里用 Claude Code 风格界面
scenarios.goal_en: Work from a Claude Code-style terminal UI
scenarios.why_zh: 全屏交互终端：状态行、思考流展开、上下文/TPS 仪表；tianshu 版本还内置 TDD 与证据门工作流。
scenarios.why_en: Full-screen interactive terminals with a live status line, thought streaming, and context/TPS gauges; the tianshu build adds TDD and evidence-gate workflows.

scenarios.goal_zh: 给 DSH 加上可审计的跨会话记忆
scenarios.goal_en: Add auditable cross-session memory
scenarios.why_zh: 五轨记忆 + 技能自进化；或 SQLite + 可编辑 Markdown 的记忆镜像，记忆透明可改。
scenarios.why_en: Five-track memory with skill self-evolution, or an SQLite + editable Markdown memory mirror you can audit.

scenarios.goal_zh: 回合结束时收到桌面通知
scenarios.goal_en: Get notified when a turn finishes
scenarios.why_zh: 按结果类型（成功/失败）控制通知，支持关键词过滤，长时间任务无需盯屏。
scenarios.why_en: Per-outcome notifications with keyword include/exclude rules so long tasks need no babysitting.

scenarios.goal_zh: 回退对话与工作区状态
scenarios.goal_en: Rewind conversation and workspace state
scenarios.why_zh: 基于持久化 Change Ledger 回退到任意早期回合，对话与代码状态一起恢复。
scenarios.why_en: Rewind to any earlier turn via a persistent Change Ledger, restoring both conversation and workspace state.

scenarios.goal_zh: 给工作区增加一个陪伴型宠物
scenarios.goal_en: Add a companion to the workspace
scenarios.why_zh: 可拖拽、投喂和玩耍的积累型鲸鱼娘桌面伙伴。
scenarios.why_en: A draggable companion with feeding, play, and persistent progression.

scenarios.goal_zh: 把其他工具的历史会话搬进 DSH
scenarios.goal_en: Migrate chat histories from other tools into DSH
scenarios.why_zh: 全保真导入 Claude Code / Codex / ChatGPT / Cursor 的聊天记录（含工具调用/思考块），导入后可直接续聊。
scenarios.why_en: Full-fidelity import of Claude Code / Codex / ChatGPT / Cursor transcripts (tools + thinking) as resumable DSH sessions.

scenarios.goal_zh: 换皮肤、自定义背景
scenarios.goal_en: Change the skin / set a custom wallpaper
scenarios.why_zh: dsh-skin 一键切换多套 --dsw-alias-* 配色并支持半透明壁纸（Codex 风格）；dsh-deep-whale 是生态内最受欢迎的鲸鱼娘皮肤系列（CC BY-NC-SA，不可商用）。
scenarios.why_en: dsh-skin switches --dsw-alias-* palettes and translucent wallpapers (Codex-style); dsh-deep-whale is the most popular whale-girl skin series (CC BY-NC-SA, non-commercial).

scenarios.goal_zh: 查看 Token 用量与费用
scenarios.goal_en: Track token usage and costs
scenarios.why_zh: 按官方政策自动计价（含峰谷时段），逐条消息记账，显示账号余额；界面语言自动切换人民币/美元。
scenarios.why_en: Auto-bill per message with official pricing (incl. peak/off-peak hours), keep a persistent cost ledger, show the account balance, and switch ¥/$ with the UI language.

scenarios.goal_zh: 让外部 Agent 驱动 Harness 执行任务
scenarios.goal_en: Drive Harness from an external agent
scenarios.why_zh: 在 Harness 内部启动 MCP server，让任意 MCP 客户端（如 Hermes）下发任务给 Harness 执行，实现「大脑 + 胳膊」协作。
scenarios.why_en: Runs an MCP server inside Harness so any MCP client (e.g. Hermes) can delegate coding tasks to Harness — a 'brain + arms' setup.

scenarios.goal_zh: 从外部设备安全访问本机 Harness
scenarios.goal_en: Access your local Harness securely from another device
scenarios.why_zh: 打印当前实例的精确连接命令：SSH 本地转发、autossh 保活、反向隧道（NAT 友好）与带 --trusted-host 的反向代理，设置页一键复制；遵循官方安全设计，不碰 0.0.0.0。
scenarios.why_en: Prints the exact commands for the live instance — SSH local forward, autossh keepalive, NAT-friendly reverse tunnel, and reverse-proxy access with --trusted-host — with one-click copy from the settings page. Respects the official safety design: no 0.0.0.0 hacks.

starter_kits.summary_zh: 先解决插件管理、后台状态和长对话导航这三个最常见的问题。
starter_kits.summary_en: Start with plugin management, background-task visibility, and long-conversation navigation.

starter_kits.summary_zh: 同时拥有定时循环和事件驱动唤醒，适合长时间、无人值守任务。
starter_kits.summary_en: Combine scheduled loops with event-driven wakeups for long-running or unattended work.

starter_kits.summary_zh: 让纯文本模型看得见、搜得到：图片结构化证据 + 带引用的网页搜索，配合原生视觉工具箱覆盖更多视觉任务。
starter_kits.summary_en: Let a text-only model see and search: structured image evidence plus cited web search, with the native vision toolkit for more visual tasks.

starter_kits.summary_zh: 让 Agent 生成交互式 UI、操作真实设计画布，并理解视觉内容。
starter_kits.summary_en: Let agents render interactive UI, operate a real design canvas, and understand visual content.

starter_kits.summary_zh: 沉淀可审计的跨会话记忆，并在回合中断后自动续跑，适合长时间无人值守项目。
starter_kits.summary_en: Build auditable cross-session memory and auto-resume interrupted turns for long unattended projects.

editor_picks.title_zh: dsh-desktop — DSH 的独立桌面客户端
editor_picks.title_en: dsh-desktop — a standalone desktop client for DSH
editor_picks.summary_zh: 社区维护的非官方桌面客户端，直接加载官方 Web UI：自动复用本机已运行的实例，也可用安装包内置的 dsh 运行时一键启动，无需额外安装 Node.js 或 CLI；支持智能连接、远程实例连接、托盘常驻和异常恢复。
editor_picks.summary_en: A community-maintained unofficial desktop client that loads DSH's official Web UI directly — auto-reuse a running local instance, or launch the bundled dsh runtime with no Node.js/CLI install required. Includes smart connect, remote-instance support, tray residency, and crash recovery.

editor_picks.title_zh: plugin-registry — 从看仓库到真正管理插件
editor_picks.title_en: plugin-registry — move from browsing to managing plugins
editor_picks.summary_zh: 面向普通用户的可视化插件管理入口，同时给开发者提供 make-dsh-plugin 引导。适合第一次进入 DSH 插件生态的人。
editor_picks.summary_en: A visual plugin-management entry point for users, paired with make-dsh-plugin guidance for developers. A strong first stop for the ecosystem.

editor_picks.title_zh: DSH-better-sidebar — 侧边栏的完整工作台
editor_picks.title_en: DSH-better-sidebar — a full workbench in the sidebar
editor_picks.summary_zh: 目前最受欢迎的侧边栏增强（460+ Star）：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，并支持第三方扩展注册新 Tab，把侧边栏变成日常开发的主界面。
editor_picks.summary_en: The most popular sidebar upgrade (460+ stars): file rendering/editing, terminal, Git, and subagents built in, plus third-party tab extensions — turning the sidebar into the daily workspace.

editor_picks.title_zh: dsh-sentinel — 让 Loop 从定时升级为事件驱动
editor_picks.title_en: dsh-sentinel — event-driven wakeups beyond schedules
editor_picks.summary_zh: 监听文件、命令、HTTP、进程或 Webhook，在条件满足时唤醒 DSH。适合自动化监控、长任务和无人值守工作流。
editor_picks.summary_en: Watch files, commands, HTTP endpoints, processes, or webhooks and wake DSH when conditions match. Built for monitoring and unattended workflows.

editor_picks.title_zh: dsh-task-status — 不再猜后台任务跑到哪了
editor_picks.title_en: dsh-task-status — see what background work is doing
editor_picks.summary_zh: 把后台任务进度和实时输出 tail 放回对话页面，尤其适合构建、下载、测试等长时间命令。
editor_picks.summary_en: Bring background-task progress and a live output tail into the conversation view, especially for builds, downloads, and long-running tests.

editor_picks.title_zh: dsh-notification — 回合完成桌面通知
editor_picks.title_en: dsh-notification — desktop notifications on turn completion
editor_picks.summary_zh: 回合完成后发送桌面通知，按成功/失败等结果分别控制，支持关键词包含/排除规则；长时间任务不用一直盯着页面。
editor_picks.summary_en: Desktop notifications when a turn completes, with per-outcome controls and keyword include/exclude rules — no need to watch the page during long tasks.

editor_picks.title_zh: dsh-annotation — 像 Codex 一样批注对话内容
editor_picks.title_en: dsh-annotation — Codex-style annotations for DSH
editor_picks.summary_zh: 选中文字、添加批注并随消息发送，回复可以逐条对照 Annotation，适合审稿、代码评审和精确反馈。
editor_picks.summary_en: Select text, attach annotations to the next message, and receive annotation-aware replies. Useful for review and precise feedback.

editor_picks.title_zh: dsh-at-file — Codex 风格的 @ 文件引用
editor_picks.title_en: dsh-at-file — Codex-style @file mentions
editor_picks.summary_zh: 在输入框里按 @ 搜索工作区文件，把内容直接附进 prompt，不用手动复制粘贴；官方 bundle，零核心改动，与 navbar/annotation 一起补全长对话体验。
editor_picks.summary_en: @-search workspace files in the composer and attach their contents to the prompt without copy-paste. Official bundle, zero core changes; completes the composer workflow with navbar/annotation.

editor_picks.title_zh: dsh-genui — 让回复变成可交互界面
editor_picks.title_en: dsh-genui — turn replies into interactive interfaces
editor_picks.summary_zh: 在对话中直接呈现图表、表单、测验、Mermaid、3D 场景，并把用户操作重新送回模型。
editor_picks.summary_en: Render charts, forms, quizzes, Mermaid diagrams, and 3D scenes inline, with user actions flowing back to the model.

editor_picks.title_zh: DSH OpenPencil — 让 Agent 操作真实设计画布
editor_picks.title_en: DSH OpenPencil — let agents work on a real design canvas
editor_picks.summary_zh: 连接 DSH 与 OpenPencil，让 Agent 理解画布结构、节点和组件关系，直接创建、修改、预览并验证可编辑的多页面设计，而不是只返回一张图片。
editor_picks.summary_en: Connect DSH to OpenPencil so agents can understand canvas structure and directly create, edit, preview, and validate editable multi-page designs instead of returning a flat image.

editor_picks.title_zh: modlens — 把图片变成结构化证据的视觉插件
editor_picks.title_en: modlens — structured visual evidence for text-only models
editor_picks.summary_zh: 生态内 Star 最高的第三方插件（900+ Star，MIT）：粘贴图片即可得到带 OCR、布局与语义的结构化 JSON 证据，让纯文本模型也能可靠地看图；配套 Web UI，与 modsearch 同一作者。
editor_picks.summary_en: The most-starred third-party plugin in the ecosystem (900+ stars, MIT): paste an image and get structured JSON evidence with OCR, layout, and semantics so text-only models can reliably see. Ships a Web UI; same author as modsearch.

editor_picks.title_zh: modsearch — 网页搜索与引用证据桥
editor_picks.title_en: modsearch — web search with cited evidence
editor_picks.summary_zh: 让 DSH 直接搜索网页和 X，返回带引用的结构化 JSON 证据（搜索/抓取/引用），纯文本模型也能基于证据回答；与 modlens 组成「看」+「搜」组合。
editor_picks.summary_en: Let DSH search the web and X and return structured JSON evidence with citations (search/fetch/cite), so text-only models answer from sources — the see+search pair with modlens.

editor_picks.title_zh: dsh-vision-toolkit — 给纯文本模型补上视觉工具箱
editor_picks.title_en: dsh-vision-toolkit — a vision toolbox for text-first models
editor_picks.summary_zh: 覆盖图片问答、长截图 OCR、UI 还原、视觉定位、像素对比和 Artifacts，适合前端与视觉任务。
editor_picks.summary_en: Cover image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, UI restoration, grounding, pixel diffs, and artifacts for frontend and visual work.

editor_picks.title_zh: whale-girl — 陪你 Vibe Coding 的鲸鱼娘
editor_picks.title_en: whale-girl — a companion for vibe coding
editor_picks.summary_zh: 可拖拽、投喂和玩耍的 DSH Web GUI 桌面宠物，为长时间 Agent 工作增加一点陪伴感。
editor_picks.summary_en: A draggable DSH Web GUI companion with feeding and play interactions for a little personality during long agent sessions.

editor_picks.title_zh: dsh-mneme — 记忆主权还给你：可读可改的跨会话记忆
editor_picks.title_en: dsh-mneme — memory sovereignty: human-editable cross-session memory
editor_picks.summary_zh: SQLite + 可人工编辑的 Markdown 镜像，记忆不再黑盒；autoDream 后台自动去重/合并/裁决，越用越精炼。记忆这回事不该让 agent 一个人说了算。
editor_picks.summary_en: SQLite + human-editable Markdown mirror keeps memory transparent — you hold the memory, not the agent. autoDream consolidates in the background.

editor_picks.title_zh: dsh-memory-evolve — 跨会话记忆与后台自我进化
editor_picks.title_en: dsh-memory-evolve — cross-session memory that evolves
editor_picks.summary_zh: 纯插件实现的五轨长期记忆：git 分支感知、回合内自我审查、技能自我进化与技能管理器、四轨待办与会话搜索——零核心修改、零运行时依赖，卸载即净。
editor_picks.summary_en: Pure-plugin five-track long-term memory: git-branch awareness, per-turn self-review, skill self-evolution with a skill manager, four-track todos, and session search — zero core changes, zero runtime deps.

editor_picks.title_zh: dsh-TUI — 给 DSH 补上全屏终端体验
editor_picks.title_en: dsh-TUI — a full-screen terminal UI for DSH
editor_picks.summary_zh: Claude Code 风格的全屏交互终端插件：像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时工作状态行、思考流式展开、双击 Esc 回滚、上下文进度条与 TPS 仪表，npm 一键安装，为偏爱 CLI 的用户补上 DSH 官方尚缺的 TUI 体验。
editor_picks.summary_en: A Claude Code-style full-screen terminal UI for DSH — pixel-whale header, a live status line, streaming thought expansion, double-Esc rollback, and a context/TPS gauge. One-command npm install, filling the TUI gap for CLI-first users.

editor_picks.title_zh: dsh-tianshu-tui — 终端 UI + 工程证据门工作流
editor_picks.title_en: dsh-tianshu-tui — terminal UI with evidence-gate workflows
editor_picks.summary_zh: 官方 Harness 上的交互式终端 UI（Apache-2.0）：在 TUI 之外内置 TDD 与「证据门」等工作流，把一次性多 Agent 调度升级为可治理的工程过程。
editor_picks.summary_en: An interactive terminal UI on the official Harness (Apache-2.0) that layers TDD and evidence-gate workflows on top of the TUI, turning one-shot agent runs into a governed engineering process.

editor_picks.title_zh: dsh-web-ui — DSH Web UI 插件与皮肤合集
editor_picks.title_en: dsh-web-ui — a plugin and skin bundle for the DSH Web UI
editor_picks.summary_zh: 一站式功能合集：任务看板、Git 关系图、侧边面板、远程移动端界面、桌面宠物、实时 Token 用量统计与皮肤中心，一次安装覆盖多个常见的界面与体验诉求。注意：仓库未声明许可证。
editor_picks.summary_en: An all-in-one bundle for the DSH Web UI — task board, git graph, a side panel, a remote mobile UI, a desktop pet, live token stats, and a skin center — covering several common UI needs in a single install. Note: no license declared.

editor_picks.title_zh: dsh-auto-continue — 请求中断后自动「继续」
editor_picks.title_en: dsh-auto-continue — auto-resume interrupted requests
editor_picks.summary_zh: 网络波动、超时或宿主崩溃导致回合失败后，自动向会话发送「继续」续跑：错误分类（认证/余额等永久性错误跳过）、自适应退避、模板化继续文本与浏览器通知，全部可在插件设置卡片中调整，无人值守也能自己爬起来。
editor_picks.summary_en: Auto-resumes turns that failed to network hiccups, timeouts, or host crashes by sending a queued "继续": error classification skips permanent failures, adaptive backoff spaces out retries, continue text supports templates, and browser notifications keep you informed — all configurable from the plugin settings card.
